data.one_liner: Extends default TabBarView to support children with dynamic heights.
data.what_it_does: The default TabBarView requires fixed heights or explicit constraints for its children. This package provides AutoScaleTabbarView, which wraps the default TabBarView and allows children to have dynamic heights.
use_when: You need a TabBarView where each tab can have a different, dynamically determined height.
You want to avoid fixed height constraints for tab contents.
avoid_when: You are already using a fixed height layout or custom scroll physics that clash with dynamic sizing.
You need complex nested scrolling views that handle their own slivers.
strengths: Solves a common layout limitation of the default Flutter TabBarView.
weaknesses: Limited documentation and examples provided in the README.
No recent updates documented in the changelog beyond early versions.
